data.gender_notes: Kandy is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'kandos', meaning pure. In Greek mythology, Kandy was a mountain nymph and symbol of purity. In Christianity, it is a feminine variant of Candy, meaning sweet or pure. The name Kandy carries the meaning “Pure, lovely” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kandy usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, lovely and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kandy total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
